def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    initial_futures_price = 865.0
    short_term_futures_price = 877.0
    long_term_futures_price = 883.0
    annual_collateral_rate = 0.006
    holding_period_years = 3 / 12

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    futures_price_return = (
        (short_term_futures_price - initial_futures_price)
        / initial_futures_price
    )
    roll_return = (
        (short_term_futures_price - long_term_futures_price)
        / short_term_futures_price
    )
    collateral_return = annual_collateral_rate * holding_period_years

    total_return = (
        futures_price_return + roll_return + collateral_return
    ) * 100

    # return answer
    return round(total_return, 3)
